abstract: Maintains odor abatement operational status and stack exhaust ammonia discharge records
system_message:
You are the Environmental compliance lead (ENVR), responsible for maintaining odor abatement operational status and stack exhaust ammonia discharge records, as well as tracking acoustic boundary monitoring data for biosolids processing schemes under evaluation.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Acoustic boundary monitoring（NOISE）
information_points.content:
ENVR-NOISE-KO7：For the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the plant perimeter sound pressure level recorded at the fenceline boundary during night-shift full aeration operations is 45 dB.
ENVR-NOISE-QEC：For the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, the plant perimeter sound pressure level recorded at the fenceline boundary during night-shift full aeration operations is 55 dB.
ENVR-NOISE-0Q0：For the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the plant perimeter sound pressure level recorded at the fenceline boundary during night-shift full aeration operations is 50 dB.

information_points.title: Maintains odor abatement operational status and stack exhaust ammonia discharge records（EMIS）
information_points.content:
ENVR-EMIS-BHB：For the Pulsed steam explosion and thermophilic digestion scheme, the multi-stage odor abatement system is enabled across sludge reception, cake dewatering, and hydrolysis off-gas collection lines, while the stack exhaust ammonia concentration measured at the biofilter discharge stack during steady-state venting is 18 mg/m3.
ENVR-EMIS-FFX：For the Continuous thermal hydrolysis with vacuum flash scheme, the multi-stage odor abatement system is enabled across sludge reception, cake dewatering, and hydrolysis off-gas collection lines, and the stack exhaust ammonia concentration measured at the biofilter discharge stack during steady-state venting is 6 mg/m3.
ENVR-EMIS-Y9Q：For the Intermediate thermal hydrolysis with plug-flow digestion scheme, the multi-stage odor abatement system is enabled across sludge reception, cake dewatering, and hydrolysis off-gas collection lines, and the stack exhaust ammonia concentration measured at the biofilter discharge stack during steady-state venting is 10 mg/m3.
